note: MV2-2 deterministic factual research backstop. National-team captaincy records — a parser-valid fact family that the v1/MV2-1 source set leaves empty (its only named source, eu-football.info, serves JS-gated empty bodies to non-browser clients and is not SHA-pinnable). Every row is a citation-backed public fact: the player's display name as the canonical card carries it, their nation, the relevant year (captaincy-defining tournament, or null for a standing current captaincy), a source-stated position, and a fetchable public citation URL plus the specific claim it supports. NO rating numbers, rankings, OVR/channel/boost/override — only the captaincy record. Each citation was fetched and confirmed to support its claim before commit. The conservative linker treats these rows identically to parser rows (unique high-confidence link only; ambiguous withheld to review); an uncited row fails the build.
